parent_links.lineage: #128 executed its frozen decision procedure exactly and stopped at the pre-registered pretrained-base admission gate (0/18 schema-valid grounded first actions under each arm; closeout docs/experiments/native-arms/issue-128-closeout.md). v2 replaces that mis-specified gate condition (pretrained-base format compliance is what process-SFT teaches, per the frozen 0/288 baseline evidence) with a post-training held-out smoke gate, keeps every other frozen element of native-arms-v1 unchanged, and completes the #128 experiment under issue #129.

visual-nomem-state.legend: Static task context, initial-state scene, current-state scene and partial-goal pages are attached. Initial/current states are unlabelled 128px scenes without text annotations. Infer dynamic state from the scene; no symbolic initial/current-state fact panels are included. Black robot silhouettes identify the agent. Goal constraints do not describe a complete solved state: unspecified facts are unconstrained. Goal blocks ALL, ANY, NOT, FOR EVERY and THERE EXISTS retain their labelled variable scopes. No Search Memory, accepted-delta window, scalar search values, candidate scores or membership flags are provided: the candidate menu lists each successor's action name and arguments only, unscored, in grounded order. No search history is provided.

visual-seq-state.legend: Static task context, initial-state scene, current-state scene and partial-goal pages are attached. Initial/current states are unlabelled 128px scenes without text annotations. Infer dynamic state from the scene; no symbolic initial/current-state fact panels are included. Black robot silhouettes identify the agent. Goal constraints do not describe a complete solved state: unspecified facts are unconstrained. Goal blocks ALL, ANY, NOT, FOR EVERY and THERE EXISTS retain their labelled variable scopes. No Search Memory, accepted-delta window, scalar search values, candidate scores or membership flags are provided: the candidate menu lists each successor's action name and arguments only, unscored, in grounded order. The current search path's most recent visited states precede the current state, attached in visit order before the current-state scene, each labelled with its absolute path position (the initial state is position 0); the current state itself is the current-state scene.

payload_reduction.frozen_source: the compact live/teacher input (schema best_first_compact_model_input_v2) built by the trusted additive session
payload_reduction.candidate_menu: list of per-candidate {name, args} only, in the trusted grounded order
payload_reduction.state_id_rationale: the standing output contract requires the operation to echo the popped frontier head; current.state_id is retained so the target remains learnable, while every g/h/priority scalar and all candidate scores/membership flags are removed

history_window.definition: path(current) is the chain of first-acceptance provenance (views registry parents, equivalently the recorded trace path for corpus records) from the initial state to the current state; the window is the last k predecessor states of path(current), in visit order, excluding the current state
history_window.label: Page role: history-state (visit ordinal {position}) with position the absolute path depth (initial state = 0)
history_window.frame_source: the same unlabelled 128px current-state rendering as the frozen visual-state arm; corpus windows rasterize retained catalog VFG vector stages on demand (CPU-only, no new rendering pipeline)
history_window.tokens_note: K=8 at the frozen 128px unlabelled rendering is approximately +4.9k input tokens, inside the 32384-token cap; the 32K gate is re-checked per observation

training.recipe: byte-identical to the study-v5 training block (LoRA r64/alpha128/dropout0.05 all-linear excl. visual, lr 1e-4 cosine, warmup 0.03, global batch 32, microbatch 1, bf16, sequential membership order, final checkpoint at update 16 only)
structural_gates: removed payload keys absent (serialized user text scanned for every removed key marker)
window states strictly precede the current state and are visit-ordered
candidate menu equals the trusted grounded order
membership identical to the frozen v5 512-record + diagnostic lists per algorithm

probe.subset: the frozen 9-task membership x both algorithms x the first decision of each task
probe.measure: share of first decisions the trusted runtime accepts (schema-valid, grounded in the unscored candidate menu, correct source_state_id)

admission_gate.rule: at or above threshold the rung proceeds; below threshold that rung declares VALID_STOP with the probe evidence published, and visual-seq-state proceeds only if its own gate passes
admission_gate.minimum_meaningful_scope: one arm passing its gate plus its complete clean evaluation; if that scope cannot fit the authorized window budget the ticket declares VALID_STOP without partial-outcome harvesting

estimand.name: native_arms_window_estimand

parameters.per_episode_price: max_observed_call_seconds from this protocol's own probe.json per arm
parameters.training_seq_scale: 1 + mean_history_frames/4 (v5 cells carry 4 images per record; the seq arm carries 4 + window frames)

estimand.not_a_completion_guarantee: runtime-enforced caps turn estimand overruns into explicit missingness; failed or cutoff attempts retain their ledger GPU hours and are reported as missing, never as silent scope reduction

clean_matrix.per_task: 2 arms x 2 algorithms x {learned_adapter, pretrained_base} = 8 GPU episodes

corruption_matrix.per_task: 2 families x 2 algorithms x {learned_adapter, pretrained_base} = 8 GPU episodes

evaluation.expansion_limit_exhaustion: a decision-call or expansion-limit exhaustion is retained as a valid unsuccessful episode
evaluation.seed_selection_rule: primes disjoint from every seed used by expanded-nine-day-v1 and #127 (17, 29, 71, 64, 1729, 90717, 42613, 1013, 2027, 3041, 4001)

control_invariance.claim: random_valid and exact_reference decisions are computed by the authoritative session from the trusted search state, never from the observed messages or images; outcomes are invariant to the observation contract
control_invariance.consequence: new-seed controls are bound per (task, algorithm, seed) with no arm; seed-17 and exact_reference comparators are reused from the replay-verified baseline store

corruption.definitions: identical to the frozen #126 family definitions (visual-blank uniform RGB(128,128,128) removal; visual-degraded 16x16 BILINEAR-down/NEAREST-up mosaic), applied to every attached image of the visual-seq-state observation (including history frames) at observe() time with the token count recomputed and the 32K gate re-checked
corruption.null_result_interpretation: under this contract images are the only state+history channel, so a non-material corruption effect is itself a leak signal and is reported as such

reused.visual-state process_sft: per (task, algorithm): the clean learned arm of every new-arm contrast
reused.visual-state pretrained_base: per (task, algorithm): the clean base comparator
reused.text-state random_valid seed 17: per (task, algorithm): the reused seed-17 control rollout
reused.text-state exact_reference: per (task, algorithm): the oracle upper bound

comparators.verification: every reused episode is independently replayed under its producing processor at finalize and its identity fields are checked against the frozen binding; any mismatch fails the finalize audit

analysis.paired_unit: whole source task instance x algorithm across conditions on identical tasks

primary_contrasts.arm_vs_published_visual: per arm: new-arm learned clean versus the published frozen visual-state learned clean (reused baseline process_sft), paired by task x algorithm (n = 18)
primary_contrasts.ladder: learned visual-seq-state minus learned visual-nomem-state, paired by task x algorithm (n = 18): the value of the image-only history window
primary_contrasts.corruption_degradation: per family: corrupted versus clean learned visual-seq-state, paired by task x algorithm (n = 18); a null effect is reported as a leak signal
primary_contrasts.learned_vs_controls: learned versus pretrained_base under the same contract; random_valid five-seed frequency; exact_reference reported separately as the oracle bound

analysis.missingness: reported per arm, family and stratum; cutoff attempts are explicit missingness, never silent scope reduction
analysis.random_valid_aggregation: per-task success frequency over the five frozen rollout seeds
analysis.tiny_subgroup_rule: strata with fewer than 8 paired instances are descriptive-only; no interval claims
analysis.saturation_rule: per issue #54, when the best control is at ceiling, make no structural-advantage claim

budget.authorization: user selection of the v2 continuation in the #128 execution session (issue #129)

admission.selection_timing: corpus/budget admission is recomputed from preparation reports, ledger spend and frozen bases only; each arm is adjudicated post-training by the frozen smoke gate

execution_contract.runtime_enforced_caps: every GPU episode is hard-capped at its priced decision-call cap (2 x reference decisions for learned cells, 1 call for pretrained_base); a cap hit is an explicit unsuccessful episode and its ledger GPU hours are retained
execution_contract.missingness_policy: estimand overruns become explicit missingness, reported per arm/family/stratum; coverage is never silently reduced
execution_contract.resume: persist each raw output before trusted-runtime submission; replay committed events and pending output before continuing
execution_contract.scheduler: scripts/run_expanded_study.py with --ledger outputs/native-arms/v1/budget.json --schedule docs/experiments/native-arms/schedule.json (declared follow-up-window scheduler extension)

declared_code_changes: examples/planning_benchmark_slice/native_arm_views.py and native_arm_corpus.py (new): the frozen observation contracts, CPU materialization and structural gates
scripts/run_expanded_native_arms.py (new): stage runner, audit hooks and frozen analysis
examples/planning_benchmark_slice/visual_model.py: train_visual gains an optional dataset_factory hook; the default path is byte-identical for every existing study config

examples/planning_benchmark_slice/expanded_scheduler.py: launch/main gain an explicit --schedule override designating a follow-up program's production ledger; behavior without --schedule is unchanged and the expanded-nine-day-v1 ledger and cutoffs are untouched

amendment.authorization: user selected the v2 continuation in the #128 execution session after reviewing the VALID_STOP diagnosis; GPU use within the remaining followup-native-arms-v1 window is authorized

smoke_gate.timing: the subset, threshold and measure are frozen in this protocol before any adapter of either arm exists
smoke_gate.subset_rule: the three cheapest tasks of the frozen 9-task membership (cheapest-prefix order of #126)
smoke_gate.condition: learned_adapter, clean contract, 2x reference decision cap, seed 17, greedy decoding
smoke_gate.measure: schema-valid grounded call rate = trusted-runtime-accepted model calls / total model calls across the arm's smoke episodes
smoke_gate.rule: at or above threshold the arm proceeds to the full frozen evaluation; below threshold that rung declares VALID_STOP with the smoke evidence published; the full panel evaluation runs only for arms passing their own gate; corruption runs only if visual-seq-state passes; gated-out bindings are published as gated_out_by_smoke, never silently dropped
smoke_gate.minimum_meaningful_scope: one arm passing its smoke gate plus its complete clean evaluation

probe.subset: the frozen 9-task membership x both algorithms x the first decision of each task
probe.measure: share of first decisions the trusted runtime accepts (schema-valid, grounded in the unscored candidate menu, correct source_state_id)

admission_gate_v1_superseded.rule: at or above threshold the rung proceeds; below threshold that rung declares VALID_STOP with the probe evidence published, and visual-seq-state proceeds only if its own gate passes
admission_gate_v1_superseded.minimum_meaningful_scope: one arm passing its gate plus its complete clean evaluation; if that scope cannot fit the authorized window budget the ticket declares VALID_STOP without partial-outcome harvesting
admission_gate_v1_superseded.superseded_by: smoke_gate (v2); the v1 probe evidence is published at outputs/native-arms/v1/probe/ and its 0/18 outcome motivated this amendment

estimand_v2.name: native_arms_window_estimand_v2
estimand_v2.probe_max_call_seconds_basis: max observed call seconds across both v1 probe reports (published evidence)
estimand_v2.not_a_completion_guarantee: runtime-enforced caps turn estimand overruns into explicit missingness; failed or cutoff attempts retain their ledger GPU hours and are reported as missing, never as silent scope reduction
